text:
Predicates:
Publishes(x) ::: x is a publishing house that specializes in translating foreign literature into English.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is a book published by y.
InEnglish(x) ::: x is in English.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x was translated from language y.
Premises:
Publishes(newVesselPress) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress) → InEnglish(x)) ::: All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
PublishedBy(neapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(palaceOfFlies, newVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
TranslatedFrom(palaceOfFlies, italian) ::: Palace of Flies was translated from Italian.
